0.0: I'm glad you've returned. Fujihawk has news.
0.1: The toad has returned. Fujihawk sensed him when he was perched atop the Daimyo's chambers. He attempted to break in and get evidence, but he didn't have his lockpicking tools with him.
0.2: Fujihawk doesn't know how he was able to kidnap the Daimyo again, but he does have a plan to stop him. There are #b#o9400403##k and #b#o9400405##k in the castle. I'd like you to collect the #b#t04000340#s#k and #b#t04000342##k from them.
0.3: The first step in Fujihawk's 26-Point Plan to Defeat the Toad is to strike a hefty blow to the #b#o9400403##k. Their #b#t04000340#s#k will serve well as a weapon against the toad. A single #b#t04000342##k from the #b#o9400405##k is also required for his special formula.
0.4: Defeat 250 #b#o9400403##k, then take 100 #b#t04000340#s#k, and 1 #b#t04000342##k to the secret contact Fujihawk has designated. I can't tell you who it is, because I can't actually understand this bird.

yes.0: Excellent. Fujihawk and I will remain ever vigilant until this castle is free again!
yes.1: If you don't know who the secret contact is, you will have to do a little detective work. Fujihawk is worried you won't learn anything otherwise.

no.0: Fujihawk says that he hopes the wind doesn't knock you in your bottom on the way out.

1.0: Everything in this castle is such a mess now... And what are you going to do about it, LANTERN?! Gah...
1.1: Oh! It's so nice to meet you, #h0#! I'm sorry for the mess, but these stupid sakura trees have NO sense of propriety.
1.2: If you're here with those hideously dangerous #b#t04000340#s#k, then you must already know that my father has been kidnapped...
